# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042)</sub>
- **Status:** married  <sub>[v3 c29 P3](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** student  <sub>[v3 c28 P0](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril is an attractive, handsome, and well-dressed young man. He possesses striking dark eyes, dark hair, and a smooth, appealing smile.

_Sources: [v3 c23 P28](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0028), [v3 c25 P42](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0042), [v3 c26 P15](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0015), [v3 c28 P0](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0000)_

## Personality

Cyril is polite, attentive, and possesses a refined demeanor. He is romantic and expressive, writing poetry for those he woos, though his romances tend to be intense and short-lived. Despite his charm, he lacks a genuine sense of humor and deep substance, which can make him seem shallow in everyday moments.

_Sources: [v3 c29 P3](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0003), [v3 c30 P15](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0015), [v3 c35 P3](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0003), [v3 c35 P42](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0042)_

## Goals

- courting and marrying Nell Harcourt  <sub>[v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017)</sub>

## History

Cyril met Nell Harcourt during her time at Wexcombe College, where he pursued her attentively. He invited her to events, sent her flowers and poetry, and eventually arranged for his family to visit her. His family held high social standing, and he remained a persistent suitor throughout her college years. After graduation, he proposed to Nell in a seaside pavilion. To his surprise, Nell turned down his proposal because she realized she did not truly love him. Following the rejection, he eventually moved past the heartbreak and married another woman.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P5](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0005), [v3 c26 P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 c28 P0](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0000), [v3 c29 P3](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0003), [v3 c36 P20](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0020), [v3 c38 P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 c38 P21](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0021)_
